display.purpose: Document title at the top of the reading column. Serif, fixed rem.

body.purpose: The reading surface. Serif, 1.72 line-height for restful long-form markdown.

label.purpose: Table headers, meta chips, sidebar markers. Sans, uppercase, tracked.

mono.purpose: Code blocks and inline code. Source Code Pro.

shadows.name: review-card-lift
shadows.purpose: Margin review cards — ambient drop plus top inset highlight so the card reads as physical paper.

shadows.name: pressed-inset
shadows.purpose: Code blocks and inputs — pressed into the paper, not raised.

motion.name: ease-state
motion.purpose: Default 120-180ms easing for hover/border/background state changes.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Solid terracotta action button — primary CTA and confirm actions.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 0.55rem; min-height: 46px; padding: 0.7rem 1.05rem; border: 1px solid var(--primary, oklch(0.48 0.14 28)); border-radius: 8px; background: var(--primary, oklch(0.48 0.14 28)); color: var(--primary-foreground, oklch(0.98 0.005 78)); font-family: 'Source Sans 3 Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 700; font-size: 0.91rem; cursor: pointer; transition: transform 0.18s ease, background 0.18s ease, border-color 0.18s ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); background: oklch(0.42 0.15 28); border-color: oklch(0.42 0.15 28); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid oklch(0.48 0.14 28); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Translucent sheet-fill button with hairline border — non-primary actions.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 0.55rem; min-height: 46px; padding: 0.7rem 1.05rem; border: 1px solid oklch(0.14 0.008 55 / 18%); border-radius: 8px; background: oklch(0.89 0.012 76 / 45%); color: oklch(0.14 0.008 55); font-family: 'Source Sans 3 Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 700; font-size: 0.91rem; cursor: pointer; transition: transform 0.18s ease, border-color 0.18s ease; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); border-color: oklch(0.14 0.008 55); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid oklch(0.48 0.14 28); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Search Input
components.description: Sidebar search / text field — pressed-paper fill with inset highlight.
components.css: .ds-input { width: 100%; height: 32px; padding: 6px 12px; border-radius: 10px; border: 1px solid oklch(0.14 0.008 55 / 12%); background: oklch(0.905 0.010 78 / 84%); color: oklch(0.14 0.008 55); font-family: 'Source Sans 3 Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.82rem; font-weight: 600; box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 oklch(1 0 0 / 35%); transition: border-color 0.12s ease, box-shadow 0.12s ease; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: oklch(0.32 0.012 65); } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: none; border-color: oklch(0.14 0.008 55 / 24%); box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 oklch(1 0 0 / 45%); }

components.name: Peer Avatar Chip
components.description: Role-colored monogram identifying owner / reviewer / agent presence. White text tuned to AA.
components.html: JRA
components.css: .ds-avatar { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; width: 1.5rem; height: 1.5rem; border-radius: 999px; color: #fff; font-family: 'Source Sans 3 Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.72rem; font-weight: 800; margin-right: 4px; } .ds-avatar--owner { background: oklch(0.58 0.14 32); } .ds-avatar--reviewer { background: oklch(0.56 0.11 235); } .ds-avatar--agent { background: oklch(0.57 0.13 295); }

components.name: Review Margin Card
components.description: The signature container — a slip of raised paper carrying a comment or suggestion, with a small accent identifying which.
components.html: R Tighten this sentence — the clause runs long.
components.css: .ds-review-card { position: relative; display: flex; gap: 10px; padding: 16px; border-radius: 10px; border: 1px solid oklch(0.14 0.008 55 / 22%); background: oklch(0.94 0.010 76 / 96%); color: oklch(0.14 0.008 55); box-shadow: 0 16px 42px oklch(0.20 0.02 55 / 16%), 0 1px 0 oklch(1 0 0 / 45%) inset; font-family: 'Source Serif 4 Variable', Georgia, serif; font-size: 0.95rem; line-height: 1.5; } .ds-review-card__accent { flex: 0 0 auto; width: 4px; align-self: stretch; border-radius: 999px; background: oklch(0.58 0.15 150); } .ds-review-card__body { display: flex; align-items: baseline; gap: 8px; }

components.name: Inline Tracked Changes
components.description: Attributed inline marks in the reading surface: green insertion, red strikethrough deletion, amber comment anchor.
components.html: The mesh moves workloads frictionlessly between owned metal and rented capacity.
components.css: .ds-track { font-family: 'Source Serif 4 Variable', Georgia, serif; font-size: 1rem; line-height: 1.72; color: oklch(0.14 0.008 55); } .ds-track ins { text-decoration: none; color: #15803d; background: rgba(34, 197, 94, 0.16); border-radius: 2px; box-decoration-break: clone; } .ds-track del { text-decoration: line-through; text-decoration-thickness: 1px; color: #b91c1c; background: rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.13); border-radius: 2px; box-decoration-break: clone; } .ds-track mark { background: oklch(0.82 0.12 85 / 22%); border-radius: 2px; box-decoration-break: clone; color: inherit; }

narrative.overview: attn is a private study where documents are read closely and marked by hand — warm paper under a desk lamp, ink that dried a century ago, a single red pencil for the one mark that matters. The surface is unmistakably editorial, but the behavior under it is a precision instrument that responds like Linear or Raycast: instant, exact, keyboard-first. Warm surface, sharp behavior. The system runs two themes from one identity — PAPER (warm parchment, light) and INK (cool blue-black, dark) — the same room at two times of day, the accent shifting warm terracotta to steel blue. It rejects three neighbors: cloud-SaaS review tools, IDEs, and rounded-pastel productivity apps.
keyCharacteristics: Serif for reading, sans for chrome, mono for code — a strict three-role split.
One accent (terracotta / steel), spent only on action, selection, and state — never decoration.
A real paper grain overlay unifies every surface, including the browser build.
Fixed rem type scale (product register): headings don't fluidly resize in a pane.
A dedicated review vocabulary: inline tracked-change marks, margin cards, role-colored peer avatars.

rules.name: The One Pencil Rule
rules.body: The primary accent is a red pencil, not a highlighter. It appears on primary action, current selection, and focus — nowhere else. If two things on a screen are terracotta, one is wrong.

rules.name: The Quarantine Rule
rules.body: Green, amber, and the peer hues belong to the collaboration layer only. They never appear as decoration on base chrome.

rules.name: The Warm-Paper, Not-Cream Rule
rules.body: The ground holds chroma ≤ 0.012. Warmth is carried by the accent and the serif, not by the background.

rules.name: The Read/Do Rule
rules.body: If the user is reading it, it's serif. If the user is operating it, it's sans. A button never uses the serif; a document heading never uses the sans.

rules.name: The Fixed-Scale Rule
rules.body: Product register: headings are fixed rem, not clamp(). A fluid h1 that shrinks in a sidebar looks worse, not better.

rules.name: The Flat-Until-Lifted Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat and tonal at rest. A shadow appears only when something is genuinely floating or genuinely pressed. Shadow states physical position, never decorative depth.

dos: Do keep the terracotta/steel accent to action, selection, and focus only — the One Pencil Rule.
Do use serif for everything read and sans for everything operated — no exceptions.
Do hold the paper ground at chroma ≤ 0.012; carry warmth through the accent and the serif.
Do keep the review hues quarantined to the collaboration layer, distinguished by meaning and attribution.
Do specify default / hover / focus-visible / active / disabled for every interactive component.
Do honor prefers-reduced-motion; keep state transitions 120-250ms and let motion convey state, not choreography.
Do carry white-on-role-hue chips at their AA-tuned lightness.
donts: Don't let attn read like a cloud-SaaS review tool (Google Docs): no account-wall chrome, no toolbar-dense header.
Don't let it read like an IDE (VS Code): no activity bars, no panels-in-panels. The reading column is the hero.
Don't let it drift toward Notion rounded-pastel: no candy-colored blocks, no emoji-forward headers.
Don't borrow the Linear-clone saturated-purple glassy gradient-glow dark theme; INK mode is a cool blue-black study.
Don't use a border-left/border-right colored stripe > 1px on cards or callouts.
Don't use gradient text, glassmorphism as a default, or a warm-cream background.
Don't let muted body text go lighter than oklch(0.32 0.012 65) on paper.
Don't fluidly clamp() UI headings; the product type scale is fixed rem.
